title: Ads
description: See what every baht of ad spend returns: spend → chats → trial shops → paid shops → revenue (suggestions only: the system never edits or pauses an ad)
ownerOnly: This page is for the CoreUp owner only
ownerOnlyHint: It shows ad spend and revenue

status.token_error: Meta refused the token, or it cannot read ads
status.rate_limited: Meta rate limit hit: the next run continues
status.noTokenHint: Ask the tech team to set META_ADS_TOKEN (a token with ads_read) on the Railway worker, then press “Sync now”. Read-only: no ad is ever changed.
status.tokenErrorHint: Check that META_ADS_TOKEN has not expired and has ads_read on this ad account.

chart.title: Ad spend vs revenue
chart.empty: No ad spend in this period yet

table.name: Name
table.unknownAd: Unknown ad (chats whose ad is not found)
table.expand: Show the ads of this campaign

goals.title: Goals for {{month}}
goals.editHint: Leave empty = no target. Money in baht.

recs.title: Suggestions
recs.suggestionOnly: Suggestions only: the system does not edit or pause any ad

cost_per_chat_high.title: Cost per chat over the line {{days}} days in a row
cost_per_chat_high.body: Cost per chat above {{thresholdMinor}} for {{days}} days ({{spendMinor}} spent, {{chats}} chats, last day {{lastDayCostPerChatMinor}} per chat). Consider pausing this ad or refreshing the creative.

frequency_high.title: People see this ad too often
frequency_high.body: Frequency {{avgDailyFrequency}} is above {{threshold}} over the last {{days}} days ({{impressions}} impressions). The creative is getting stale: try a new image/video.

spend_no_trials.title: Spent, chats came, but no trial shop
spend_no_trials.body: {{spendMinor}} spent in {{days}} days, {{chats}} chats and nobody started a trial. Do not add budget: fix the chat closing first (send the demo shop link, offer a call).

best_cost_per_trial.title: This ad gets trial shops the cheapest
best_cost_per_trial.body: {{trials}} trial shops at {{costPerTrialMinor}} each over {{days}} days, against “{{fromAd}}” ({{fromSpendMinor}} spent, {{fromCostPerTrialMinor}} per trial). Consider moving budget to this ad.

placement_cheaper.title: Reels is cheaper than feed
placement_cheaper.body: Reels {{reelsCostPerChatMinor}} per chat ({{reelsChats}} chats) vs feed {{feedCostPerChatMinor}} per chat ({{feedChats}} chats) over {{days}} days. Make more 9:16 videos.

chats_unanswered.title: {{count}} chats waiting more than 1 hour
chats_unanswered.body: Longest wait {{oldestHours}} h. Use the ready message below (a person sends it).

chats_stalled.title: {{count}} chats went quiet after our question
chats_stalled.body: Quiet for up to {{oldestHours}} h. Follow up with the ready message below (a person sends it).

chats.title: Chats still worth closing: ready messages
chats.hint: A person can answer in Business Suite for 7 days after the customer's last message. The system sends nothing.

report.title: Weekly marketing summary (AI)
report.hint: Written every Monday from the numbers on this page only
report.empty: No report yet. It is written next Monday, or create one now.
report.timedOut: No new report within 2 minutes. Do not press again: ask the tech team to check ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and that the week had spend/chats.
